title: Triviality over a field detected by a nonempty invertible pullback
statement: Let $K$ be a field and let $Y$ be a nonempty scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Let $p:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}(K)$ be a morphism and let $N$ be a finite locally free module [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf] on $\operatorname{Spec}(K)$. If the tensor pullback $p^*N$ [def-pc-module-pullback] is invertible [def-sc-invertible-module], then $N\cong\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}(K)}$. Here finite locally free means a Zariski open cover with finite free restrictions; no rank is fixed in advance.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Tag 0BF0 (lemma-get-a-closed), generic-field step in its use of Tag 0BDP; Modules, Tag 01C6 (definition-locally-free)

proof.text: Finite local freeness gives a neighbourhood U of the unique point of Spec K and a finite type I with N restricted to U isomorphic to the free module on I (Scheme.Modules.exists_mem_over_iso_free). Since U contains that point it is top. overIsoFreeEquiv and isoFreeOfRestrictIso turn the restriction isomorphism into N ≅ O_K^I. These are proved source-library declarations; the top-open inclusion is an isomorphism.

Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies tensor pullback with Scheme.Modules.pullback. Choose a point y of Y and an invertible trivialization on an open V containing y. pullbackComp and pullbackFreeIso show that N pulled back along V→Y→Spec K is both O_V and the free module on I. No stalk or residue-field comparison is needed.

V is nonempty, hence Γ(V,O_V) is a nontrivial commutative ring (Scheme.component_nontrivial). Apply appLinearEquivOfIso and freeSectionsEquiv to the two isomorphisms. Mathlib supplies the strong rank condition through the retained proof imports, so Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card and Module.finrank_self identify card I with 1. Fintype.card_eq_one_iff supplies a Unique instance on I, and coproductUniqueIso identifies the free module on I with O_K. Compose with the global presentation of N.

theorem nonempty_iso_unit_of_invertible_field_pullback
    (K : Type u) [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [Nonempty Y]
    (p : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    (N : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).Modules) [N.IsFiniteLocallyFree]
    [((tensorPullback p).obj N).IsInvertible] :
    Nonempty (N ≅ SheafOfModules.unit _)
